| Category = Apple recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 3 Honeycrisp [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled, cored, and sliced into 12ths
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Coffee Liqueur|coffee liqueur]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] strong [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]], cooled
* 3 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
== Procedure ==
#Melt 1 tbsp butter in a stainless steel [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat. Add apples and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] just until browned around edges. Remove and keep warm.
#Meanwhile, combine liqueurs. Add to pan, turn heat off, and ignite. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and start scraping browned bits.
#Add remaining ingredients to pan and bring to a boil over medium heat until reduced by ⅓.
#Add apples and toss to coat.
#Serve warm.
